instruction: Write a Bash script that takes a source directory and a destination and copies only files modified in the last 24 hours.
Write a script that rotates a log file: compress the old one and start a fresh file.
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
log=$1
[ -f "$log" ] || exit 0
gzip -f "$log"
touch "$log"

instruction: Write a Bash function that converts all .md files in a directory to .html using pandoc.
output:
md2html() {
  local f
  for f in "$1"/*.md; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    pandoc "$f" -o "${f%.md}.html"
  done
}

instruction: Write a script that monitors a log file and prints an alert when the word FATAL appears more than 5 times in a minute.
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
tail -F -n0 "$1" | while IFS= read -r line; do
  if [[ $line == *FATAL* ]]; then
    printf '[%s] ALERT: %s\n' "$(date '+%T')" "$line"
  fi
done

instruction: Write a script that batch-renames files by lowercasing their names.
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
for f in *; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  lower=${f,,}
  [[ $f == "$lower" ]] || mv -- "$f" "$lower"
done

instruction: Write a script that generates a report of file counts grouped by extension.
Write a Bash script that polls two services and reports which one is down.
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
for url in http://a/health http://b/health; do
  if curl -fsS -m 3 -o /dev/null "$url"; then
    printf 'up   %s\n' "$url"
  else
    printf 'down %s\n' "$url"
  fi
done

instruction: Write a script that extracts tar archives of every type found in a directory.
Write a script that merges multiple CSV files sharing a header into one output file.
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
out=$1; shift
head -n1 -- "$1" > "$out"
for f in "$@"; do
  tail -n +2 -- "$f" >> "$out"
done

instruction: Write a script that builds a Docker image and tags it with the current git short hash.
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
hash=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
docker build -t "myapp:${hash}" .

instruction: Write a Bash script that validates every JSON file in a directory and reports the failures.
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
status=0
for f in *.json; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  if ! python3 -m json.tool "$f" >/dev/null; then
    printf 'invalid: %s\n' "$f" >&2
    status=1
  fi
done
exit "$status"

Write a script that backups a PostgreSQL database using pg_dump with a timestamped filename.
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ts=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
pg_dump -Fc -f "db-${ts}.dump" "$DB_NAME"

instruction: Write a script that sums file sizes in a directory and prints a human-readable total.
Write a Bash script that prompts for confirmation before deleting files (read -p).
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
printf 'Delete %s? [y/N] ' "$1"
read -r ans
[[ ${ans,,} == y ]] && rm -rf -- "$1" || echo aborted

instruction: Write a script that converts temperatures in a column of a text file from F to C.
Write a script that creates N empty files with a numeric suffix, given a base name and count.
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
base=$1 n=$2
for ((i=1; i<=n; i++)); do
  : > "${base}-$(printf '%03d' "$i").dat"
done

Write a script that deploys by rsyncing a build dir to a remote host and restarting a service.
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
rsync -az --delete ./dist/ user@host:/var/www/app/
ssh user@host 'sudo systemctl restart app'

instruction: Write a script that reads a list of URLs from a file and reports the HTTP status of each.
output:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
while IFS= read -r url; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 5 "$url")
  printf '%s %s\n' "$code" "$url"
done < urls.txt
